title: One name for the final round a fix check leaves owed
why: R9 (retrospective relay, 16:07 CST Nov 10) calls the review a fix check leaves owed 'round 3'. merge --review-record records it as the next round number instead (round 2 after a lone round 1), and refuses a round 3 with no round 2. On 2026-11-10 triage first left that review off the record for #2570 and #1338, then recorded it as round 2 at 17:43 CST. Fix: the rule and the tool use one name for it (step rounds-rules-one-record).
